statement: It would also be interesting to better understand the limitations and trade-offs in this and similar models. For example, what regimes of parameter allow constant-competitive or (1 − ε)-competitive algorithms?
context: A natural follow-up question is how our results could generalize to other settings. In particular, it would be interesting to extend our algorithm and analysis to packing LPs. The difficulty in using our technique is that there is no natural notion similar to the weighted rank for this setting. It would also be interesting to better understand the limitations and trade-offs in this and similar models. For example, what regimes of parameter allow constant-competitive or (1 − ε)-competitive algorithms?
